name: Jerod's Landing
summary: Defias smugglers hold Jerod's Landing on the Elwynn Forest bank of the Nazferiti River. The dock gives them a hidden route for illicit shipments across the kingdom's waterways.

sections.title: A Smuggler's Waypoint
sections.body: Defias outlaws now control the river dock at Jerod's Landing, where Elwynn Forest meets the waters of the Nazferiti River. Once an ordinary boat dock, it now receives goods plundered from the Redridge Mountains under a Defias dockmaster's watch. The outlaws move the cargo discreetly downstream toward holdings such as Klaven's Tower in Westfall.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Jerod's Landing's place on the river has drawn SI:7, Stormwind's covert intelligence network. Its operatives watch Defias activity there and see the dock as a vital link in the syndicate's supply lines. Resourceful rogues slip inside, steal river shipment ledgers, and work to unravel the wider conspiracy strangling the kingdom.

faq.answer: Jerod's Landing lies in eastern Elwynn Forest, on the western bank of the Nazferiti River, which marks the boundary between Elwynn and the Redridge Mountains.
Members of the Defias Brotherhood occupy Jerod's Landing. A Defias dockmaster coordinates shipments with armed bandits guarding the waterside.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this dock for the Defias?
aliases: why do defias use jerods landing
faq.answer: The Brotherhood uses Jerod's Landing to smuggle stolen goods and weaponry taken in the Redridge Mountains toward rogue strongholds such as Klaven's Tower in Westfall.

faq.q: Why is SI:7 interested in Jerod's Landing?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw and his intelligence agents track Defias contraband through Jerod's Landing to expose the network linking Westfall, Elwynn, and Redridge.

angles.text: As a rogue working for SI:7, you are sent to Jerod's Landing to test your stealth, pickpocket the Defias dockmaster, and recover sensitive trade ledgers.
As an Alliance member, you can see how thoroughly the Defias have compromised the waterways linking Elwynn to Redridge, right beneath Stormwind's nose.
